method: PARAPHRASED AND HASH-ANCHORED from German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021' (published 21 April 2022). Every claim is a paraphrase backed by anchors (scripts/anchor.py): verify.py --source re-finds each anchored span in a fresh copy of the source, checks the claim's numbers against it and rejects copying. LICENCE: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (read at Europe PMC fullTextXML <license> element for PMC9325452). The source's words are NOT reproduced here. The stage-by-stage treatment tables (Tables 7 and 8) and diagnostic/staging tables were stripped; claims rest on the narrative text.

claims.claim: **Cutaneous lymphomas arise in the skin with no other organ involved at staging**; about 73% are T-cell types. They must be told apart from skin spread of nodal lymphoma or leukaemia, which is managed very differently.
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Manage jointly between a specialist centre and the primary doctor.**
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Clinical findings often suggest the diagnosis, but confirm it with histology, immunohistology and molecular tests**; examine the whole skin and every lymph node region.
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Stage MF and SS with the revised TNMB system.** Early MF (IA-IIA) usually carries a very good outlook, with mean survival of about 10 to 20 years.
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Treat by entity and stage, and keep treatment restrained** for the common CTCL types.
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **In early stages, prefer skin-directed options:** topical steroids, phototherapy, topical chlormethine (or carmustine), bexarotene gel or imiquimod.
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Phototherapy for stages IA-IIA:** narrow-band UVB (311 nm) or PUVA. Reserve PUVA mainly for thick plaques or folliculotropic MF; either suits erythrodermic MF.
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Radiotherapy:** for localised CTCL, at least 30 Gy in 2 Gy fractions controls 90-100% of lesions long term. Low-dose palliative radiotherapy (8 Gy, given as one or two fractions) gave complete remission in at least 92%.
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Total skin electron beam:** conventional doses (30-36 Gy) work but are harsher on the skin; low-dose 10-12 Gy over 2-3 weeks is a safer short-term option, followed by maintenance treatment.
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Advanced stages call for systemic treatment**, typically PUVA combined with a retinoid or interferon-alpha; bexarotene is also recommended.
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Conventional interferon-alpha (Roferon) is no longer available;** pegylated interferon is used off-label; in a small series peginterferon alfa-2a at 180 μg weekly worked as well as higher doses. Start at a moderate dose and watch for liver and marrow toxicity.
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Brentuximab vedotin is an option for advanced CD30-positive MF** (tumour stage).
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Mogamulizumab (anti-CCR4, approved 2019) is a second-line systemic option** for refractory or advanced MF and for SS after at least one prior systemic therapy; it works especially well on blood involvement.
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **HDAC inhibitors (vorinostat, romidepsin) and pralatrexate are alternatives** approved in the USA rather than Europe.
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Prefer single-agent chemotherapy** (for example low-dose gemcitabine or doxorubicin) to combination regimens, which cause heavy immunosuppression without improving survival.
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Extracorporeal photopheresis works in SS with few side effects**, alone or with interferon-alpha, PUVA, topical steroids or bexarotene.
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Second-choice options in SS:** bexarotene or low-dose methotrexate (ideally with PUVA and photopheresis), or total skin electron beam. Doxorubicin or gemcitabine can debulk advanced SS; use alemtuzumab at low doses to limit infection.
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Allogeneic stem cell transplant may suit selected patients.** Palliative chemotherapy in late stages has no proven survival benefit and adds infection risk.
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **After remission or down-staging of advanced disease, maintain with the guideline's non-cytotoxic treatments.**
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **For itch (off-label):** in CTCL, gabapentin 300 to 2400 mg/day, or mirtazapine 7.5-30 mg taken at bedtime; in SS, aprepitant 80 mg/day.
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Follow-up aims to catch relapse, second lymphomas and treatment harms** (such as PUVA-related skin cancers). Teach every patient to check their own skin and feel their lymph nodes regularly.
claims.locator: German Dermatological Society / German Cancer Society guideline group (Dippel E, Assaf C, Becker JC, et al.), Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft, 'S2k-Guidelines – Cutaneous lymphomas (ICD10 C82 - C86): Update 2021', published 21 April 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9325452/, retrieved 2026-09-23
